title: I made a free survivors-like roguelite you can play in your browser or on your phone – 5 acts, 12 bosses, branching paths
author: Background_Ranger667
selftext:
Hey everyone!
    
    
    I've been working on 
    **Hollowdelve**
    , a small action roguelite in the style of Vampire Survivors, but with a Slay-the-Spire-like map. Your weapons fire on their own – you move, dodge and pick your path through five acts with eight rooms each.
    
    
    **What's in it:**
    
    
    - 6 classes (Knight, Ninja, Fire Mage, Hunter, Samurai, Monk), each with its own special ability
    - 14 weapons that evolve, 29 relics (some of them cursed)
    - 5 elements with 10 reactions (freeze + shock, burn + poison …)
    - 12 bosses with telegraphed attacks and an enraged second phase
    - Branching act map: fights, elites, shops, shrines, rest sites and random encounters (gamblers, a soul witch, a gladiator …)
    - Reroll & banish on level-ups, permanent upgrades, bestiary
    - Auto-saves after every room, so it works well for short sessions on the phone
    
    
    It's completely free, no ads, no sign-up. Runs in the browser on PC and mobile (portrait mode).
    
    
    **Play it here:**
     https://binjack.itch.io/hollowdelve
    
    
    **Transparency:**
     I made this together with an AI (Claude) – it wrote the code based on my ideas and feedback. All the art, music and sound are hand-made CC0/free assets by human artists (Ninja Adventure by Pixel-boy & AAA, DungeonTileset II by 0x72, SFX by Leohpaz). No AI art.
    
    
    The balance is still a work in progress, so I'd really love to hear: Which act got too hard or too easy for you? Which class did you enjoy the most?
    
    
    Thanks for playing! 🗡️
